newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Cassa di Risparmio A long term rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Cassa di Risparmio A long term rating.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency said on Thursday it affirmed the ratings of Italy's Cassa di Risparmio in Bologna (CRB) at A1 short-term and A long-term, with an individual rating of B/C and a legal rating of 4.
"CRB has been successful in holding its important market share in the wealthy region of Emilia Romagna in the north of Italy," IBCA said.

Its entrance in the medium/long-term lending market, through the merger with BIMER, should be able to provide important economies of scale. The bank remains strongly capitalised with an end-1995 EU total capital ratio of 12.91 percent.
